# Rescorer test fixtures: sentence sources and licences

Paths in this file are relative to the parent folder of the repository (the `AFM Input/` workspace described in
`docs/BUILDING.md`). The generator scripts live there, not in this repository.

| Fixture | Sentences | Source / licence | Generator |
|---|---|---|---|
| `sloth_fixture.tsv` (5 rows), `electra_fixture.tsv` (6), `de_fixture.tsv` (6) | `d00x` (everyday) and `m00x` (medical) rows of the project's own 300-sentence bench (`bench/data/testset.jsonl`) | Written for this project (LLM-authored test sentences, not taken from an external corpus); released with this repository under its MIT licence | `bench/src/make_fixtures_DE.py` and the original Sloth/ELECTRA parity scripts |
| `personal_override_fixture.tsv` | Same rows as `sloth_fixture.tsv` | As above | `Source/Engine/Personalize/tools/make_fixtures.py` |
| `precise_fixture.jsonl` (80 rows) | General test set, Common Voice zh-TW rows only (`source` = `cv:*`) | Mozilla Common Voice zh-TW sentence files, **CC0-1.0** (github.com/common-voice/common-voice, `server/data/zh-TW/`) | `bench/src/precise_calib.py --fixture-only` |
| `rwalk_fixture.tsv` (50 rows) | First 50 Common Voice rows of the general dev set | Common Voice zh-TW, **CC0-1.0** | `bench/src/make_rwalk_fixture.py` |
| `rwalk_app_parity.tsv` (6 rows) | General dev rows where R-walk differs from the stock walk, Common Voice rows only | Common Voice zh-TW, **CC0-1.0** | `rescorer_bench --walk-mode` (see the file header) |

Candidate strings, scores and readings in the fixtures are produced by McBopomofo's language model (`Source/Data`,
MIT) and the project's own models; they are not copied from any corpus.

Not contained (removed 2026-10-08 before publication): zh.wikipedia text (CC BY-SA 4.0), SlothLM-E test-set
sentences, Tatoeba sentences, and any text generated by Apple Foundation Models.
